GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Four Wide , in 3 Wide at 1100m, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept trying in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed lameness in the off hindleg. Vet clearance required.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after jumping, shifted in and bumped a runner. Raced wide and without cover throughout the early stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame in the off hind leg (2/5). Cleared.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok settled down 4 Lengths off the lead Two Wide (1000m), Under Pressure 500, whip before Turn no run on # struggling b4 turn

Jumped well landing in front soon headed content to drift back 3 Lengths Two Wide (1000m), between rivals at times Ridden Along approaching Turn , Straightened Up all Clear , leader dashed away this held Ground only # dash home no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1000m, steadied when awkwardly placed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 3 lengths, railed up to within a length and a quarter approaching turn , shifted Two Wide into turn, hit Lead Straightening Up and kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in when placed under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok going Through between rivals Soon After Settled Down second 3 Wide though 2 Lengths (1000m), Two Wide Soon After , same 600, niggled Soon After & again wide, cornered third, faded to last (hung throughout) # wide/hung/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung in near the 1000m. Approaching the 400m, bumped and became unbalanced. Rdr reported mount hung in throughout. Warning on the gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to Turn then Hooked Out to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , hit Lead Straightening Up and kept going to post # solid win
Jumped well Settled Down third off the fence 3 Lengths (1200m), margin 4 Lengths 600, cornered same although wider trying to run on, couldn't # couldn't finish off
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th Inside 6 Lengths Good Pace on, trav well within 4 Lengths x 400m, clear run home but then couldn't quicken and # couldn't finish off
Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Made Some Ground in Straight without ever looking the winner # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was eased out around heels to continue to improve. Hampered and carried wider near the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, shifted out around heels after straightening up, ran on making up fair ground late. Was well up in class here. # ran on ok late
